description.description: Description for this key (max 50 chars, alphanumeric/hyphens/spaces)

ephemeral.description: (auth only) Whether devices using this key are ephemeral (default: false)

expirySeconds.description: (auth only) Key expiry in seconds (default: 90 days)

keyType.description: Key type: 'auth' (default) for device auth keys, 'client' for OAuth clients, 'federated' for OIDC federation

preauthorized.description: (auth only) Whether devices are pre-authorized (default: false)

reusable.description: (auth only) Whether the key can be used more than once (default: false)

scopes.description: (client/federated) OAuth scopes to grant (e.g. ['devices:core:read', 'dns:read']). Use the current scope names listed at https://tailscale.com/kb/1623/trust-credentials#scopes; the pre-2024 names such as 'devices:read' and 'acl' are legacy.

subject.description: (federated only) Expected subject claim, supports * wildcards

tags.description: ACL tags (must start with 'tag:'). Required for client/federated if scopes include 'devices:core' or 'auth_keys'

name: tailscale_create_key
title: Create key
